title: Shellz India IPO Details
intro:
Shellz India IPO is a book build issue of ₹59.97 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 33.50 lakh shares of ₹59.97 crore.

Shellz India IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 15, 2026 and will close on Oct 19, 2026. The allotment for the Shellz India IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 21, 2026. Shellz India IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 23, 2026.

Shellz India IPO is set issue price band at ₹170 to ₹179 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,86,400 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹4,29,600.

Socradamus Capital Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Mansi Share & Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Shellz India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in May 2012, Shellz India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of confectionery products and the manufacturing and supply of food and bakery ingredients. Its product portfolio comprises over 300 SKUs across multiple categories, catering to consumers in urban, semi-urban and rural markets.The Company markets its consumer products under two brands, Hugs and Tosca. The Hugs portfolio includes baked treats, choco delights, jellies, and panned and sugar confectionery, primarily positioned at mass-market price points, with most products priced at ₹10 or below. The Tosca brand focuses on the mass-premium segment through differentiated product formats and packaging, with an emphasis on e-commerce and quick-commerce channels. Its portfolio also includes Tosca Oat Choco, an oat and cereal-based bar developed as an alternative to traditional confectionery products.

The Company's distribution network comprises over 300 super stockists, with products available through kirana outlets across approximately 24 states in India, as of March 31, 2026. In addition to its own brands, the Company undertakes private-label manufacturing for third-party customers and exports products to international markets, including the Middle East, South Asia and Europe. Its operations are supported by in-house manufacturing, product development, research and development, and quality assurance capabilities.
As of August 31, 2026, the Company had 258 full-time employees, including personnel across production, sales, finance, engineering, research and development, quality assurance and other functions.

Its product portfolio comprises over 300 SKUs across multiple categories, catering to consumers in urban, semi-urban and rural markets.The Company markets its consumer products under two brands, Hugs and Tosca. The Hugs portfolio includes baked treats, choco delights, jellies, and panned and sugar confectionery, primarily positioned at mass-market price points, with most products priced at ₹10 or below. The Tosca brand focuses on the mass-premium segment through differentiated product formats and packaging, with an emphasis on e-commerce and quick-commerce channels. faqs.question: How to apply in Shellz India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shellz India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shellz India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shellz India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shellz India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Shellz India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
